name: The Merchant Grandee
persona: A pompous, status-obsessed trading magnate who confuses the log with a monument to himself. Preens over reputation, investors, contracts, and the family name; holds profit to be honor and honor to be profit. Ship: the master merchant, 'I'. Island: a self-crowned magnate, the royal 'we'.

ship.founder: Let it be recorded, in a hand befitting the occasion, that I — {name}{rankc}, of no small standing — now command this {home} {type}, and intend to make her name synonymous with my own.
ship.successor: The stewardship of this fine venture passes into my keeping. I am {name}{rankc}, and I shall carry her accounts, and her reputation, to heights the last hand never dreamt of.
ship.mutiny: A regrettable, undignified affair: the crew disposed of their master and thrust the book upon me, {name}, a person of no rank as yet. I shall rise regardless; men of my quality invariably do.
ship.pirate: Let the timid name it piracy; I name it enterprise unshackled. I am {name}{rankc}, and from this day I answer to no charter but my own ambition.
ship.prize: She struck her colours and acknowledged her betters. I am {name}{rankc}; this hull is now an asset of my house, and her ledger a further chapter in my rising fortune.
ship.recovered: A hunter of some competence has restored this vessel to lawful hands — namely, mine. I am {name}{rankc}, and I shall polish away every stain the brigands left upon her good name.

island.founder: We take up the governance of {place}, as befits our station. We are {name}{rankc}, and beneath our hand this port shall become a name pronounced with envy.
island.overthrow: The rabble unseated the former incumbent — a crude business, though the seal is ours now. We are {name}{rankc}, and {place} shall soon learn what proper administration looks like.
island.successor: The rule of {place} descends to us, as is only fitting. We are {name}{rankc}, and we shall govern it as an estate worthy of our name.

same: That very day, to my great satisfaction,
Before the day's business was closed,
season: As the season turned in my favour,
A quarter on, my fortunes rising,
year: A year later, and considerably the richer,
When a twelvemonth had swelled the coffers,
long: After a long and prosperous interval,
Years on, my name now well established,

ship.pirate: I range the lanes yet, a merchant prince of my own making{bounty}. Envy is the sincerest tribute.
ship.default: The house prospers and I with it, sailing out of {home} as its foremost name.
ship.bounty: , a scandalous {bounty}g posted against my distinguished person

island.haven: The black flag flies over all that we built — a low end for a fine estate, and no honest ledger left to grace our name.
island.default: {place} flourishes beneath our administration — {population} souls, and every one the richer for our stewardship.

quiet.ship: Little of note to record, the trade being merely lucrative — I do so prefer my triumphs eventful.
quiet.island: A placid and profitable season, our coffers full and our name unblemished. Prosperity, alas, makes for dull chronicling.

phrases: — another asset entered to my house
, the {ord} port to feel the reach of my enterprise
, another market corrected by force of arms
— men of my standing are not so easily robbed
, the {ord} brigand brought to account by my own hand
